plugins.name: Node + inkos
plugins.author: LxChat
plugins.description: Node.js (>=22.5, powers node:sqlite) bundled with the @actalk/inkos novel-writing engine (AGPL-3.0). Lets the assistant write long-form fiction chapters using your configured model key. Binary from nodejs-mobile android-arm64 build; inkos packaged unmodified as an independent process.

plugins.name: webnovel-writer
plugins.author: LxChat
plugins.description: webnovel-writer (GPL-3.0) long-form novel consistency engine: init settings / plan volume & chapters / write / review / query persisted state. Requires runtime-python (auto-installs). Long-form consistency: fact settling to queryable state so hundreds of chapters keep settings, foreshadowing and timelines consistent.
